title: buddleja vetula var. major
intro: Buddleja vetula var. major, commonly known as the butterfly bush, is a plant species within the Buddlejaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant known for its long, conical panicles of small, fragrant flowers that attract butterflies and other pollinators. The health benefits of Buddleja vetula var. major include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an antiseptic and astringent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
